snippet.title: Dig Too Deep | Official Trailer | Roguelite Tower Defense
snippet.description:
#DigTooDeep #steamnextfest  #indiegames 

Goblins are your weapons. Goblins are your workers. Goblins are your only hope. Wishlist Dig Too Deep on Steam now and play the free demo during Steam Next Fest June 15-22, 2026.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4280850/Dig_Too_Deep/

Dig Too Deep is a chaotic action physics roguelite tower defense where you play as a mighty Troll directing a crew of surprisingly enthusiastic goblins. Throw them at mines for ore, forges for steel, and enemies who have the nerve to show up at your base. Build your defenses, choose your perks, and survive escalating waves -- or start over. Every run is different. Every throw matters.

▶ Play the demo free during Steam Next Fest June 15-22, 2026

🌐 Game Website: https://digtoodeep.com
